UULTIS /MATERIAL / TEXTURE / FORM

The character of materials.

A closer look at the surfaces, structures and tactile qualities behind the collection.

Wood

Natural grain, knots and tonal variation give each piece its own character. Wood brings visual warmth and material strength.

Fusing glass

Large surfaces combine precision and an artisanal character, adding depth and light to the design.

Technological stone

Large-format Italian stone offers varied surface expressions. Finishes include Calacatta Black, Calacatta Michelangelo and Verde Alpi.

Knit fabric

Three-dimensional knitting follows organic forms with continuous surfaces, elasticity and breathability.

Natural marble

White Paraná and black Kouros marble bring distinctive veining, tonal contrast and natural variation.

Technical textiles

Pima Cotton, Thermal Cold and Magma Sense expand the range of tactile and comfort experiences. Confirm specifications for your selected piece.

Photography illustrates the material language. Finishes and specifications vary by product; consult its technical sheet.
